title: Mouse waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- greeting sparkle lines (drawn under mouse) -->
  <line x1='72' y1='20' x2='74' y2='13' stroke='#FFE96B' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='80' y1='24' x2='87' y2='20' stroke='#FFE96B' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='84' y1='33' x2='92' y2='33' stroke='#FFE96B' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M28 76 Q14 78 12 66 Q11 57 19 57' fill='none' stroke='#E89AAE' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='23' ry='20' fill='#B9C3D6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#DCE3EE'/>

  <!-- left arm resting -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='68' rx='5' ry='8' fill='#B9C3D6'/>

  <!-- right arm waving -->
  <path d='M70 66 Q78 56 82 45' fill='none' stroke='#B9C3D6' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='42' r='7' fill='#DCE3EE'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='32' r='14' fill='#B9C3D6'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='32' r='8' fill='#F2A9BE'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='32' r='14' fill='#B9C3D6'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='32' r='8' fill='#F2A9BE'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='24' fill='#DCE3EE'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='42' r='5' fill='#2B2440'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='42' r='5' fill='#2B2440'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='40.5' r='1.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='40.5' r='1.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#F2A9BE'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#E0507A'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M50 54 Q50 60 43 59' fill='none' stroke='#C43A63' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 54 Q50 60 57 59' fill='none' stroke='#C43A63' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='38' y1='52' x2='22' y2='48' stroke='#8F9BB5' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='56' x2='21' y2='57' stroke='#8F9BB5' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='52' x2='78' y2='48' stroke='#8F9BB5' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='56' x2='79' y2='57' stroke='#8F9BB5' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='91' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#C6A0B4'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='91' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#C6A0B4'/>
</svg>
